target_customer: Banks, fintechs, crypto firms and credit unions with AML, KYC and KYB operations
problem: Compliance analysts manually review alerts and onboarding cases. Sphinx agents work inside existing tools to make AML decisions with audit trails.
business_model: B2B enterprise software sold on demo led contracts; pricing not published
product_category: AI compliance agents for financial crime operations

founders.name: Alexandre Berkovic
founders.background_notes: Multimodal generative AI research at Imperial and MIT (YC page).

founders.name: Chrisjan Wust
prior_employers: RelyComply (early hire; title differs by source)
founders.background_notes: Education not listed. Sources disagree on his RelyComply role and scale ($12M ARR vs 12M or 15M users).

competitors.name: Greenlite
competitors.what: AI agents for routine AML and KYC tasks at fintechs
competitors.traction_then: YC launch page for AI compliance teams for fintechs

technical_complexity.rationale: Browser native agents must follow analyst procedures, handle adverse media, PEP and sanctions checks and produce regulator ready audit trails; hard parts are accuracy and trust, not research breakthroughs.

defensibility.rationale: SOC 2 Type II, audit trails and embedded workflows help, but several funded AML agent vendors (Greenlite, Sardine, Unit21, Hummingbird) offer similar agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent compliance vendors added agent features by 2026; no sourced acquisition of Sphinx.

market_need_then: Banks and fintechs face onboarding bottlenecks and costly manual compliance reviews; the company reports customers such as Axos Bank and Current (vendor claim, undated).

branding.domain_note: Uses sphinxhq.com, an HQ suffix variant; the Sphinx name is shared with a documentation tool and a counterintelligence firm.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident enterprise voice: command center for financial operations, your last compliance hire

branding.community_and_virality: Coverage of the seed in many fintech trade outlets; no merch or fan community.

brand_strength.rationale: The riddle themed name suits compliance decisions and the tagline is memorable, but the name is confusable with other Sphinx brands.

outcome_analysis: Sphinx joined YC F24 with founders who had already exited Adorno AI and built AML systems at RelyComply. By February 2026 it raised a $7.1M seed led by Cherry Ventures and reported millions of alerts processed in production. The AI agents wave and bank demand for lower compliance cost are tailwinds, while funded rivals are a risk. No exit or shutdown was found.
notes: Seed confirmed by the company release, Cherry Ventures and several trade outlets. Any earlier pre seed or YC deal was not found. Greenlite competitor entry is dated only to 2024 from its YC launch page; Sardine, Unit21 and Hummingbird evidence is 2026 so not listed as of founding. Customer and result figures are vendor claims.
